title: Dimension drop for a principal Cartier subscheme of an affine variety
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $A$ be a nonzero finitely generated $k$-algebra such that $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-pc-integral-scheme] is integral and of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. If $f\in A$ is nonzero and not a unit, then the affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}(A/(f))$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-pc-scheme] has Krull dimension $\dim(\operatorname{Spec}(A))-1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].
